answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 53638 Country: MY Title: Spiritual decease Question: I do work of tabligh. I can feel inside my body have makhluq like jinn. That makhluq is controlling my mind. That makhluq makes me to do bad thing. I find it difficult to sleep if sleep I have bad dream and it is difficult to wake up. Sometime that makhluq makes me afraid until I can't drive. I think that makhluq is long time already inside my body. I go many places already to cure my decease but failed. Please give me advise or any suggestion what to do. Answer ID: 53638 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1388/1223/B=08/1435) Get complete Surah al-Baqarah recited by any pious person and blow it on water. Drink that water for forty days. Also recite بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم after each salah 100 times. In-shaAllah, all the effects of jinn shall be removed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
